main_text.p: re, remigare: Item Ire, ambulare, progredi, profi- cisci: Item Fluere. Ithpeh. אִתְרְדִי, לְגַרְדּ Castigari, erudiri: & actívè Castigare, Levit.20.5. in Jon. Arari, Jerem.26.18. Mich.3.v.ult.

דְּרִי Ch. Dominans, dominator, Pf.110.2. Exactor, Jobi 39.7. Castigans, erudiens: Arans, arator. Plural. תְּרִין רְדִין, רְדָיָא: Huc referendum juxta quosdam, תְּרִין רְדִינִין Duos dominatores, principes, Esth.6.10. in T. sec. Elias in Meturgeman retulit ad רְדָד, quasi esset idem quod רְדִידִין Vela, Pepla. Deinde רְדָיָא Fluenta, Hebr. נְהָלִים, ex significatione hujus verbi Syriaca, Prov. 5.15. Elias Syrae linguae imperitus ignoravit quid significet.
רִידְיָא vel רְדָיָא Ch. Aratio, Exo.34.21. in Jon.
מוּרְדְּנִיתָא Ch. Aratio; Sulcus, Striga, Psal.129.3.
מְרַדְיָא Ch. Ligo. Plur. מְרָדְיָא, Psal.141.7.
מַרְדָא Ch. Extensum, diffusum: vel Tenerum, Jesa.17. 6. Forte est a רְדַד.
רְדוּת, רְדוּן Ch. Rhedae, currus, Exo.14.25. T. Jon.
מַרְדוּתָא, מַרְדוּתָא, מַרְדוּתָא Ch. & Syr. Castigatio, erudi- tio, disciplina, institutio. Plur. מַרְדְּוָן, emph. מַרְדוּתָא, Levit.26.23. in Jon.
Syr. Didascalus, praeceptor, doctor, ad Ro- man.2.20.
Syr. Fluxus, Marc.5.25. Item Navigatio, Actor.27.10.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Aramaic script is rendered approximately in Latin-letter transliteration for the Hebrew words and may not reproduce the exact pointing of the original. Several Syriac entries are only partly legible at the scan's edge; the vocalisation marks are uncertain.
